runtime_users: authorized ChatGPT/OpenAI runtime acting inside an admitted OpenSiro OSS work item
technical_permissions: read public repository files, metadata, issues, pull requests, commits and workflow state
create/update issues and pull requests when connector authorization allows
create/update repository content on branches when connector authorization allows
merge pull requests when connector authorization and repository policy allow
actual available operations remain bounded by the live connector authorization and GitHub policy

actions: search/read primary evidence for an admitted work item
delegated.rationale: Read access is ordinary support when it stays inside the admitted work/evidence boundary.

actions: create/update a bounded issue or work record
create/update files on a non-default branch
open/update a pull request for already-admitted work
delegated.rationale: These mutations may transport an already-delegated S1/metasystem decision without widening organizational authority.

actions: merge a pull request into the default/protected branch
parent_gated.rationale: Current owner-only integration policy gates shared/default-state changes. This gate is not automatically S5; classify the underlying organizational decision separately.

actions: expand integration permissions or reachable resources
change organization permissions or security-sensitive access
parent_gated.rationale: These actions change capability/security/governance surfaces and require explicit parent authorization or a later separately delegated governance path.

actions: use technically available access against repositories/resources outside the admitted work boundary
silently broaden resource scope to continue after authorization failure
change secrets/credentials through ordinary agent work
bypass an explicit parent gate or repository protection
forbidden.rationale: Technical capability does not widen the organizational delegation envelope.

revocation.path: narrow/disconnect/revoke the integration through the provider/GitHub authorization surface; affected runtime work fails closed until re-entry

failure_behavior: stop the affected mutation when authentication or permission state is inconsistent with this entry
request re-entry or parent intervention instead of silently broadening scope
do not treat missing tool access as permission to substitute another unadmitted external capability
reentry_triggers: technical permissions materially expand or contract
provider behavior changes the risk/meaning of an existing capability
evidence_retention: pinned revision or merge commit where relevant
Organization decision/control records for consequential actions
explicit failure/no-change evidence when an action cannot be completed
notes: This entry records the organizational use envelope, not a promise that every listed technical operation is always exposed by the live connector.
The GitHub connector remains transport/support and does not own S1-S5 functions.
